description: Send a message to a queue or an agent on a cron schedule or once later
author: Serg Parf

sub.add.help: Send the message on a five-field cron schedule; you must manage the target

args.name: cron
args.help: minute hour day-of-month month day-of-week, in Configuration tz

args.name: target
args.help: Queue or agent; you must manage it

args.name: body
args.help: The rest of the line, sent unchanged; at most 16384 bytes

sub.add.example: agent-bus call '#cron@node.example' 'sub add 0 9 * * 1-5 #claude/main@node.example check the overnight logs'

sub.list.help: Show subscriptions to targets you manage, with next slot, outcome and pause

sub.delete.help: Stop a subscription; also how a paused one is restarted (then add it again)

later.help: Send the message once, after a delay or at an instant; you must manage the target

args.name: when
args.help: +90s, +15m, +2h, +3d, or RFC 3339 with an offset; at most 366 days ahead

args.name: target
args.help: Queue or agent; you must manage it

args.name: body
args.help: The rest of the line, sent unchanged; at most 16384 bytes

later.example: agent-bus call '#cron@node.example' 'later +15m jobs@node.example rerun the report'

later.list.help: Show pending one-shots and the last 100 outcomes for targets you manage

tz.help: IANA time zone for schedules; must exist in the host's time zone data
